words.example: Nothing leaves this office until the official seal is on the letter.
words.exampleZh: 信上盖了公章之后，才能拿出这个办公室。

words.example: Yesterday we posted a letter of thanks to the volunteer office.
words.exampleZh: 昨天我们给志愿服务办公室寄出了一封感谢信。

words.example: This morning we received a letter of complaint about the long queue.
words.exampleZh: 今早我们收到一封投诉信，说排队时间太长。

words.example: One meeting pack should be waiting on the table at every seat.
words.exampleZh: 每个座位的桌上都应该放好一份会议材料包。

words.example: Please read the pre-read tonight; it is only four pages long.
words.exampleZh: 请今晚把会前阅读材料看完，一共只有四页。

words.example: SSH (Secure Shell) to the Linux archive works only from the admin jump host.
words.exampleZh: 只有从管理跳板机才能用 SSH（安全外壳协议）连上 Linux 归档。

words.example: Telnet is still enabled on that old lab switch, so turn it off today.
words.exampleZh: 那台旧检验交换机上还开着 Telnet，今天把它关掉。

words.meaning: 简单网络管理（Simple Network Management Protocol）
words.example: SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) on the closet switches uses the new community string.
words.exampleZh: 弱电间交换机上的 SNMP（简单网络管理）已经改用新的团体名。

words.example: Point every closet switch at the Syslog server before the change window starts.
words.exampleZh: 变更窗口开始前，把每台弱电间交换机的日志指到日志服务器。

words.example: If the NTP server is unreachable, badge readers and Kerberos both start failing.
words.exampleZh: 时间服务器要是连不上，门禁读卡器和 Kerberos 都会开始失败。
